answer: Invariant: a fresh identity cluster can buy influence only in proportion to slashable bonds it locks across edges into the existing trust trellis. Condition one: each newcomer needs two sponsors from disjoint neighborhoods, so a sybil oasis cannot self-vouch in a closed loop. Condition two: every sponsorship edge posts timber-denominated collateral that decays and slashes on defection, making fake clusters expensive to sustain after real work stops.
